jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Solutions – Finance and Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description

Ready to build your career? We want to hear from you.

Under the leadership of the Vice President, Integrated Management Systems, the Director, Enterprise Solutions – Finance and Operations is responsible for the strategy, evolution, operations, and value creation of the platforms that support Pomerleau’s finance functions and construction operations.

This mandate includes platforms that support accounting, payroll, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, project financial management, and construction operations. It encompasses both the operation and enhancement of current platforms, including CMiC and Procore, as well as the transformation associated with the deployment of the new financial system and the future PMIS.

The Director defines the portfolio roadmap, ensures business continuity throughout the transformation, and prepares the processes, data, integrations, teams, and operating model required to support future platforms.

Working closely with the Finance function and Construction business units, the Director translates business priorities into functional and technology capabilities, ensuring that platforms effectively meet organizational needs.

The Director leads the functional and technical teams, as well as external partners, responsible for platform evolution, integration, operations, and support. They are accountable for platform stability, performance, user adoption, and the value generated for the organization.

What you will do

Finance And Construction Operations

Act as the owner of the portfolio of platforms supporting Finance functions and Construction Operations.
Be accountable for the satisfaction of Finance functions and Construction business units with respect to the capabilities provided.
Understand challenges related to accounting, payroll, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, project financial management, and construction execution in order to guide priorities.
Ensure that business functions and operating sectors have the platforms, data, and processes required to achieve their objectives.
Continuously measure and improve the value generated by the platforms.

Portfolio Strategy And Evolution

Define the long-term vision for Finance and Operations platforms.
Develop a multi-year roadmap aligned with corporate objectives and the priorities of Finance functions and Construction business units.
Anticipate the evolution of financial practices, including payroll, accounts payable and receivable, accounting, procurement, project management, and construction operations.
Define the investments and priorities required to evolve the portfolio.
Maintain the right balance between business continuity, immediate needs, and future capabilities.

Finance And PMIS Transformation

Play a leading role in the design and deployment of the new financial system and future PMIS.
Ensure the continuity, stability, and evolution of CMiC and Procore throughout the transformation.
Plan the transition, data migration, integrations, and coexistence of current and future platforms.
Partner with Finance functions and Construction business units to transform processes and realize expected business benefits.
Prepare teams, operating models, and internal capabilities required to support the new platforms.
Manage risks, dependencies, and operational impacts associated with the transformation.

Practice Leadership

Lead the functional, technical, integration, and development teams responsible for the platforms.
Develop the internal capabilities required to operate and evolve the portfolio.
Oversee capacity planning and resource management for internal teams and external partners.
Foster a culture focused on service excellence, business partnership, accountability, and value creation.

Software Governance And Architecture

Establish functional and technical governance for the platforms within the portfolio.
Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and technology frameworks.
Provide direction on platform configurations, custom development, integrations, and extensions.
Collaborate with architecture, data, integration, and cybersecurity teams to ensure robust, secure, and scalable platforms.
Ensure consistency of processes, data, and integrations across the portfolio.

Delivery And Operational Performance

Be accountable for the availability, stability, security, and performance of the platforms.
Ensure initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and achieve expected outcomes.
Implement governance and performance monitoring mechanisms at the operational, tactical, and strategic levels.
Manage risks, issues, and dependencies across the portfolio.
Ensure the quality, adoption, and business value realization of deployed platforms.

Vendor And Partner Management

Define the strategy for leveraging software vendors, systems integrators, consultants, and specialized partners.
Manage relationships with strategic vendors and partners.
Participate in contract negotiations and agreement management.
Optimize value delivered by external partners and the cost of platforms and services.
Establish a sustainable balance between internal capabilities and external expertise.

This role could be for you if you have

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 10 years of experience managing complex enterprise platforms.
Significant experience with an ERP, financial system, or PMIS.
Experience with solutions supporting multiple financial functions, including accounting, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, procurement, and project financial management.
Strong understanding of financial and operational processes and their translation into integrated technology capabilities.
Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and external partners.
Experience managing large-scale transformation programs.
Experience in construction, infrastructure, or a project-based environment is considered a strong asset.
Experience in platform governance and strategic vendor management.

Key Competencies

Strategic leadership
Customer focus and value creation
Understanding of financial functions and processes, including payroll, accounts payable, and accounts receivable
Understanding of construction operations and project management
Enterprise platform management
Governance and portfolio management
Change and transformation management
Executive communication
Stakeholder influence and management
Vendor and partner management
Strategic thinking and decision-making
Collaboration and pragmatism

Benefits

RRSP with up to 5% employer matching
Hybrid work model for corporate roles
Employee stock ownership program
Career growth through real development opportunities
Transit pass reimbursement — get to work for free
Minimum 4 weeks of vacation from day one

For the past six years, we've proudly held the distinction of being one of Canada's Top 100 Employers.

Pomerleau is a national leader in construction, delivering major projects across Canada. We believe in creating a workplace where people feel respected, supported, and empowered to grow. Our culture is built on collaboration, trust, and a shared commitment to doing great work. If this speaks to you, apply for this role or connect with one of our recruiters to learn how we can support you throughout the process.

jobs.title: Director, AI Business Enablement
jobs.description:
Job Description

What's the opportunity?

We're looking for a driven problem-solver with AI fluency and business acumen who can partner with senior business stakeholders to identify and develop high-impact AI transformation opportunities. As a Director on the AI Business Enablement team, you will own a sub-segment within a Line of Business or Function — driving opportunity identification, solution concept development, and program framing in close collaboration with your vertical leadership.

You will engage VP/SVP-level business leaders with credibility and rigour — bringing a blend of consultative problem-solving, AI knowledge, and hands-on experience delivering technology-driven outcomes.

Your responsibilities will include:

Business stakeholder engagement: Building and maintaining strong relationships with VP/SVP-level business leaders within your sub-segment; understanding their priorities, pain points, and transformation opportunities
Pipeline development: Identifying, sizing, and developing AI transformation opportunities within your sub-segment — contributing to a rigorous pipeline with quantified value hypotheses ready for delivery intake
AI solution concept development: Generating innovative AI solution concepts for business problems and supporting validation through rapid POC cycles (weeks, not quarters)
Business model & process re-engineering: Working with business stakeholders to rethink processes and operating models through an AI-enabled lens
Program framing: Supporting business case development, go-to-market strategy, and program framing to ensure ideas translate into executable plans
Delivery partnership: Working closely with our AI Solutions and Research teams to ensure business context and outcomes expectations are carried through into delivery — maintaining alignment between transformation ambition and the technical execution path
Cross-enterprise collaboration: Contributing to cross-vertical pattern recognition by surfacing reuse opportunities and horizontal themes observed within domain

You're our ideal candidate if you:

Have 8–12 years of progressive experience in management consulting, technology, AI/ML product development, or a combination thereof
Have a track record of contributing to the delivery of AI or technology-driven solutions that created material business impact — strategy and advisory experience is valued, but must be complemented by hands-on involvement in delivery outcomes
Can engage VP/SVP-level business stakeholders with credibility — able to earn trust, challenge thinking, and drive alignment
Have demonstrated experience in process re-engineering or business model redesign, ideally enabled by technology or data
Have experience partnering with technical or engineering teams to translate business requirements into solution design and ensure delivery stays aligned to intended business outcomes
Bring a consultative problem-solving approach — able to structure ambiguous problems, develop hypotheses, and drive to action quickly
Have a working knowledge of AI/ML technologies, LLMs, and data platforms — sufficient to credibly assess feasibility, shape solution concepts, and engage technical teams
Banking or financial services experience is welcome but not required; what matters is the ability to rapidly develop domain depth and business-model understanding in complex industries

What's in it for you:

Drive AI transformation at one of Canada's largest and most respected financial institutions, with exposure to senior leadership across RBC
Be part of a newly formed, high-impact function within RBC's AI Group alongside experienced transformation leaders
A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock options where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact from a local-to-global scale

About the AI Group:

RBC's AI Group is the AI accelerator for RBC, with a focus on driving the shift from early-stage AI projects to scaled, client outcomes that amplify the impact of RBC's people. In addition to helping scale the biggest AI opportunities at RBC, the AI Group is responsible for advancing research into emerging use cases across generative and agentic AI, while maintaining expertise in security, responsible AI and regulatory expectations. The Business Enablement function within the AI Group partners with LOBs and Functions to set AI ambition, originate transformation opportunities, and frame programs for delivery — ensuring RBC remains at the frontier of AI-enabled value creation.

Inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment

RBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans status, Aboriginal/Native American status or any other legally-protected factors. Disability-related accommodations during the application process are available upon request.

Job Skills

Big Data Analytics, Client Counseling, Coaching Others, Critical Thinking, Decision Making, Industry Knowledge, Machine Learning (ML), Results-Oriented, Software Engineering, Software Product Design

jobs.title: Director AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Position Description

CGI is Canada's largest independent information technology services firm, and after 50 years, we continue to grow. We are building a new AI engineering capability within our Toronto Financial Services (TFS) business unit, serving clients across Banking, Insurance, and Wealth Management.

We are looking for a Director, Consulting Services to build and lead this new capability. This is a people leadership role with accountability for the team, delivery, and client relationships. The AI engineering team will report to this role, including Forward Deployed Engineer / AI Co-op, Agentic AI Engineers, Founding AI Engineers, and the Distinguished AI Engineer.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will stay close to the work by building demos, helping shape complex solutions, and setting technical direction alongside the team. As a player-coach, you will develop people, build trusted client relationships, grow the capability, and remain actively engaged in how solutions are designed and built.

This role is hybrid and requires you to work from our downtown Toronto office and/or client office a minimum of two days per week, subject to change at any time.

Your future duties and responsibilities

Build, grow, and lead the AI engineering team, including hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

Own delivery across client engagements, with accountability for timelines, quality, and business value.

Build and maintain senior client relationships, develop trusted partnerships, grow accounts, and identify new opportunities.

Remain hands-on by building demos and proofs of concept and contributing to complex solutions.

Set technical direction and engineering standards for AI solutions in collaboration with the Distinguished AI Engineer.

Shape AI roadmaps and business cases in collaboration with CGI and client leadership.

Own estimates, budgets, and delivery plans for the team's work.

Maintain high standards for quality, security, and reliability across delivered solutions.

Build an inclusive, collaborative team culture that supports continuous learning and professional growth.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

12+ years of experience in software delivery or consulting, including experience leading teams.

Demonstrated people leadership experience building and leading engineering or delivery teams, including hiring, coaching, career development, and performance management.

Strong, current hands-on technical skills, with the ability to build demos and complex full-stack solutions using Java and Node.js and AI coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, or Claude Code.

Strong knowledge of building AI and agent-based products, including prompt, context, harness, and loop engineering.

Demonstrated experience owning client delivery, including estimates, budgets, plans, timelines, and quality.

Experience developing trusted relationships with senior client leaders and identifying opportunities to grow accounts.

Strong technical understanding of APIs, databases including PostgreSQL and MongoDB, and cloud technologies to effectively guide engineering teams.

Ability to connect AI initiatives to defined business outcomes and value.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts clearly to executives, clients, and engineering teams.

Assets

Experience in Banking, Insurance, or Wealth Management.

Experience establishing and growing a new practice or capability.

Consulting or professional services experience.

Public contributions to the AI community through speaking engagements, published writing, or open-source work.

Relevant cloud or delivery certifications, including Azure, AWS, or GCP.

**CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $145,000–$195,000. This role is an existing vacancy.**

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.
